key_terms.الصَّيْرَفِيُّ: Al-Sayrafī, a nisba indicating profession or origin (money-changer/coin examiner)
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, a technical term in hadith sciences describing a narrator with less than perfect reliability
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ: Muhammad ibn al-Walid, a specific narrator

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Sayrafī and what is his status as a narrator?
ai.summary: This is a brief biographical note from the book *Kitab al-Du'afa* (The Book of Weak Narrators), identifying Muhammad ibn al-Walid, known as al-Sayrafī, as a weak (*da'if*) narrator in hadith transmission.
